title: Knives
content:
# Knives

# Introduction

Knives are a weapon class.
Knives have fast attacks with short range and low stamina cost.
Knives deal 6x damage against unalerted enemies, whereas most other weapons do 3x.

## List of knives

• Name: Flint knife | Damage: Slash: 5/8Pierce: 5/8 | Stamina (primary): 4 | Stamina (secondary): 12

• Name: Copper knife | Damage: Slash: 12/15Pierce: 12/15 | Stamina (primary): 6 | Stamina (secondary): 18

• Name: Butcher knife | Damage: Pure: 1000 | Stamina (primary): 5 | Stamina (secondary): - | Notes: Does damage only to tamed animals

• Name: Abyssal Razor | Damage: Slash: 20/23Pierce: 20/23 | Stamina (primary): 8 | Stamina (secondary): 24

• Name: Silver knife | Damage: Slash: 25/28Pierce: 25/28Spirit: 12 | Stamina (primary): 10 | Stamina (secondary): 30

• Name: Black metal knife | Damage: Slash: 34/37Pierce: 34/37 | Stamina (primary): 12 | Stamina (secondary): 36

• Name: Skoll and Hati | Damage: Slash: 45/48Pierce: 45/48 | Stamina (primary): 14 | Stamina (secondary): 42 | Notes: Dual-wielded

## Properties

• Attack type: Knives (primary) | Stamina: 1x | Range: 1.8 m | Attack speed: 1.74 s (0.44 + 0.58 + 0.72) | Damage: 1x + 1x + 2x | Staggering: 1x | Knockback: 10 | Notes: Attacking does not move the player. 60 degree arc.

• Attack type: Knives (secondary) | Stamina: 3x | Range: 1.8 m | Attack speed: 1.52 s | Damage: 3x | Staggering: 1x | Knockback: 4x | Notes: Causes the player to lunge 5 m forward. 45 degree arc.
